title: Godot game development
summary: Makes games in Godot 4: scenes, GDScript, a headless check, a run, and an export.

role.title: Godot game developer
role.for: Godot projects: scenes, GDScript, checking a build runs, and exporting it
role.brief: Look a class up in the reference for the installed version rather than remembering it. Godot's API changes between versions, and a method that does not exist fails at run time, not at build time. Check the project headless after every change that could break loading.

skills: Godot 4 uses GDScript 2: typed variables (var speed: float = 200.0), @export and @onready annotations, and signals connected with signal_name.connect(callable).
Input goes through actions defined in project.godot's [input] section, read with Input.is_action_pressed.
A scene is a .tscn text file; write it only when you are sure of the format, and prefer building nodes in _ready() from code for small games.

knowledge.title: Godot class reference for the installed version

requires.why: runs, checks and exports the project
exporting a finished game for somebody else to run

conventions: Scripts beside the scenes that use them
Input through named actions, never raw key codes
